## Professional Summary

Wasim M Ansari is an AI/ML Engineer and GenAI Solution Architect specializing in production Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Neo4j Knowledge Graphs, hybrid RAG retrieval, time-series forecasting, and end-to-end MLOps (FastAPI, Docker, Google Cloud Run, Azure). He brings a unique combination of deep technical execution in machine learning and 8+ years of cross-industry commercial leadership across legal services, real estate, and international trade.

## Core Technical Skills

- **Generative AI & Agentic Systems:** LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Agno, Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients & servers, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Human-in-the-Loop AI, Self-Healing Ingestion, Prompt Engineering & Eval.
- **Machine Learning & Deep Learning:** PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, Transformers Fine-Tuning, Time-Series Forecasting (TSB/Croston, ARIMA), Computer Vision (CNNs, VGG16).
- **Retrieval & Knowledge Graphs:** Neo4j (Cypher graph traversal), FAISS, ChromaDB, Hybrid Vector + Graph Search, Redis (caching & task broker), MongoDB, Pydantic Schema Validation.
- **MLOps & Cloud Infrastructure:** FastAPI, Docker containerization, Celery distributed task queues, Google Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Microsoft Azure AI, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Vercel, HuggingFace Spaces.
- **Data Analytics & Observability:** Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, LangSmith tracing, Weights & Biases (WandB), TrackIO, Prometheus metrics, n8n workflow automation.
- **Standards & Compliance:** GDPR data handling, ISO 27001 awareness, Agile/SCRUM.

## Flagship Enterprise & Production Projects

### 1. HyreFast Intelligence Layer (Confidential POC — SpearHub)
- Platform: https://www.hyrefast.ai/ (Private Client POC)
- Summary: Designed and built an end-to-end recruiter intelligence layer on LangGraph, FastAPI, Neo4j, Redis, Celery, Pydantic, Ollama, and MCP.
- Architecture:
  - Ingestion: PyMuPDF/pdfplumber parser with LLM structuring and Pydantic validation guarantees.
  - Self-Healing Loop: Classified-error repair loop with history-aware retry prompting for real-world resume variance.
  - Skill Normalization: Multi-stage matching (Exact lookup → BM25 full-text → lexical scoring → synonym expansion → Neo4j traversal against 12,000+ skills).
  - Graph Retrieval: Neo4j Cypher queries optimized for 1-2 hop candidate-role matching with privacy-preserving workspace isolation.

### 2. Zovia Inventory Forecasting Module (Confidential ERP Module — SpearHub)
- Platform: https://www.zovia.ai/ (Private Client Module)
- Summary: ERP-integrated forecasting API predicting weekly/monthly warehouse stock IN/OUT movement for manufacturing supply chains.
- Architecture:
  - Demand Engine: Teunter-Syntetos-Babai (TSB) algorithm for sporadic, intermittent industrial parts demand.
  - Risk Simulation: Monte Carlo stochastic confidence intervals for overstock and stockout mitigation.
  - Async Processing: Celery + Redis distributed background workers with webhook callbacks to ERP platforms.
  - Automated Visuals: Matplotlib visualization generator outputting trend charts and KPIs.
